jobs.description: Requires 4+ years of experience. 4+ years of development experience with Scala or another JVM language Extensive hands-on experience with scalable and distributed systems architecture and design Extensive hands-on experience with data streaming technologies, including Apache Kafka, Spark Streaming, Kafka Streams, or Apache Flink

jobs.title: AI Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: Extensive product management experience in B2B SaaS, specifically leading 0-to-1 product units with a founder-level mindset Practical AI application experience (LLMs, RAG, or AI agents) to solve real-world problems and translate model strengths/limitations into practical UX decisions Non-negotiable cybersecurity mastery with deep, hands-on technical understanding of how vulnerabilities and exploits work at the code and infrastructure level

jobs.title: Solution Engineer (Pre-Sales)
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. Minimum 5 years of experience in a customer-facing role such as pre-sales, solutions engineering, or technical architecture In-depth knowledge of Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry Proven ability in technical integrations and conducting Proof of Concepts (POCs)

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer - Datastores
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, platform engineering, or infrastructure roles Experience maintaining datastores in high-scale environments (relational DBs or distributed datastores such as MongoDB, Cassandra, ClickHouse, Redis, OpenSearch) Experience running stateful workloads in Kubernetes

jobs.title: Compliance reporting
jobs.description: Skip to content Compliance for all your AI agents Compliance reporting Coralogix’s AI Center unifies all your regulatory evidence in one live dashboard Get a Demo Read the docs Comply with every law and regulation ISO/IEC 42001 ready Show full ISO 42001 coverage—from risk logs to improvement KPIs. NIST AI RMF aligned Map agent data to IDENTIFY‑MANAGE‑GOVERN‑MEASURE for provable trust. Global AI acts covered Real‑time scores keep you ahead of EU, US, and future AI laws. Complete visibility into your compliance landscape Live compliance scorecards Instant dashboards map each agent against legal mandates—transparency, risk, privacy, and robustness—showing real‑time scores and pinpointing exactly where you fall short. Evidence at your fingertips Generate audit‑ready packs in seconds: conversation logs, eval scores, lineage, and risk snapshots tied to every clause of ISO 42001, NIST RMF, EU/US AI acts. Actionable remediation workflows See each requirement, which agents pass it, plus guidance to close gaps. Track fixes in one workspace until every framework box is ticked. Scalable observability for your AI agents Platform Overview In-stream analysis Continuous, real-time monitoring of AI interactions, detecting risks and performance issues before they impact users. Infinite retention Ensures historical AI data remains accessible for long-term trend analysis and deep troubleshooting without data loss. Cost optimization Tracks token usage and suspicious resource consumption, helping teams prevent cost overruns while maintaining AI efficiency. Remote, index-free querying Lightning-fast searches without the overhead of indexing, ensuring real-time AI observability without unnecessary storage costs.
